Game Overview

At its heart, Sane Runner is a action game about sprint through a perilous pixel landscape in Sane Runner, where timing is everything. Master jumps, defy gravity, and adapt to dynamic NFT challenges. Will you conquer the blockchain-infused course, or will the terrain get the best of you? Embrace the thrill and become the ultimate runner!
